sql: SELECT release_type, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'yes') AS n_counted FROM raw.frontier_model_candidates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 51
SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'yes') AS n_counted FROM raw.frontier_model_candidates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 51
SELECT developer, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'yes') AS n_counted FROM raw.frontier_model_candidates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 51

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE "window" <> CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) - CAST('2026-09-12' AS DATE) BETWEEN -30 AND -1 THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) - CAST('2026-09-12' AS DATE) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 'after' ELSE 'outside' END) AS window_mismatches, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'yes' AND "window" = 'outside') AS counted_outside, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'yes' AND top_tier IS NULL) AS counted_missing_top_tier, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'no' AND NOT top_tier IS NULL) AS excluded_with_top_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT developer || '|' || model) AS distinct_dev_model, MIN(CAST(date AS DATE)) AS min_date, MAX(CAST(date AS DATE)) AS max_date FROM raw.frontier_model_candidates LIMIT 51

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(source_url, 'https?://(www\.)?([^/]+)', 2) AS domain, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'yes') AS n_counted FROM raw.frontier_model_candidates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 51

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE notes ILIKE '%date-sensitive%') AS date_sensitive_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE notes ILIKE 'Excluded:%') AS excluded_notes, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counted = 'no' AND notes NOT ILIKE 'Excluded:%') AS excluded_without_reason, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE notes ILIKE '%outside the 13-lab list%') AS borderline_lab_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE notes ILIKE '%Counted once%') AS counted_once_rows FROM raw.frontier_model_candidates LIMIT 51

SELECT comparison_id, before_count, after_count, change, rate_ratio, ROUND(p_value_two_sided, 6) AS p, ROUND(p_value_bonferroni, 6) AS p_bonf FROM marts_dev.rpt_rate_tests ORDER BY comparison_order LIMIT 51
SELECT gap_position, COUNT(*) AS gaps, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap, ROUND(AVG(gap_days), 3) AS avg_gap, SUM(gap_days) AS total_days FROM marts_dev.rpt_release_gaps GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 51
SELECT gap_start_date, gap_end_date, gap_days, start_window, end_window FROM marts_dev.rpt_release_gaps WHERE gap_position = 'across_essay' OR gap_days >= 6 ORDER BY gap_start_date LIMIT 51
SELECT top_tier_kind, essay_window, access_level, COUNT(*) AS n FROM marts_dev.fct_release_candidates WHERE is_counted GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL LIMIT 51
SELECT model_name, essay_window, essay_window_alt_date, launch_event FROM marts_dev.fct_release_candidates WHERE has_date_conflict OR NOT launch_event IS NULL ORDER BY model_name LIMIT 51
SELECT exclusion_category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM marts_dev.fct_release_candidates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 51
SELECT week_from_essay, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE is_counted) AS counted, COUNT(*) AS candidates FROM marts_dev.fct_release_candidates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 51
